fact: The OTR says individual taxpayers can now create or recover their tax identification number (NIF) online at nif.otr.tg, presented 18 December 2023.
OTR says individuals can create a NIF particulier online at nif.otr.tg or at tax offices, the platform also searching existing NIFs and issuing a registration sheet.
OTR says article 7 of the tax procedures book requires one unique NIF per taxpayer, and the individual NIF is required for customs clearance of personal goods and for property registration.
